evidence.intree_statement: Definition double_dual (d : C) : C ⟶ C := dual d ◯ (dual d)^op.
star_double_dual {x : C} : x ≅ double_dual dualizer x;  (class field of StarAutonomous)

statement_record.book: Parallel example to the character-group discussion: a finite-dimensional vector space is naturally isomorphic to its double dual (whereas the isomorphism to the single dual is basis-dependent and not natural).
